title: 454 बनाम 2: महिला आरक्षण कब लागू? #Shorts
description:
454 बनाम 2: नारी शक्ति वंदन अधिनियम पास हो चुका है, तो महिलाओं को सीटें कब मिलेंगी? जानिए क्रम: पहले जनगणना, फिर परिसीमन, फिर लोकसभा, राज्य विधानसभाओं और दिल्ली में एक-तिहाई सीटें महिलाओं के लिए, और आरक्षण शुरू होने से 15 साल तक।

आपकी राय: क्या सीटों का रोटेशन परिसीमन के तुरंत बाद शुरू होना चाहिए? कमेंट में बताइए।

ध्यान दें: वीडियो का अंतिम हिस्सा हमारी टिप्पणी (Opinion) है।

स्रोत: लोकसभा/राज्यसभा रिकॉर्ड, PRS India, जनगणना भारत अधिसूचना (16 जून 2025)।
चित्र: Wikimedia Commons (क्रेडिट वीडियो में); स्टॉक क्लिप: Pixabay।

#नारीशक्तिवंदन #महिलाआरक्षण #PoliticsExplained #IndianPolitics #Shorts

script:
CHANNEL: yt-sankalp (live). SLOT: 9 PM IST today, Short 2 of 2. English master; system posts only the Hindi dub (hi-IN voices).
ENGLISH MASTER TITLE: 454 to 2: Women's Quota Explained #Shorts

CAST: Rohan and Kavya only (channel's fixed anchors, standard looks and voices). No other characters. No AI faces of real people.

FINAL SCRIPT (fact-checked):
ROHAN: 454 to 2 in the Lok Sabha. The law is passed. So why aren't women getting the seats yet?
KAVYA: The Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam sets an order. One-third of seats in the Lok Sabha, state assemblies and Delhi are reserved for women, but only after a census and delimitation.
ROHAN: Here's what people miss: this bill stalled for decades. A version passed the Rajya Sabha in 2010, then lapsed.
KAVYA: In 2023, the Rajya Sabha passed it with no votes against.
ROHAN: Critics say the wait delays the benefit. They wanted it sooner.
KAVYA: The case for the order: fresh census data, then redrawn constituencies, so the seats are fair, and the quota runs 15 years from when it starts.
ROHAN: For most of India, the census reference date is 1 March 2027. In our view, the real test is seat rotation, which a future law must spell out.
KAVYA: Should rotation start right after delimitation? Tell us below.
